title: JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon autonomous research has shown promise in accelerating scientific progress through sustained cycles of hypothesis generation, implementation, and validation. However, this Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm relies on reactive trial-and-error, where costly and time-consuming executions introduce severe feedback delays, throttling evolutionary progress under explosively expanding search space. To address this challenge, we propose JANUS, a framework that unifies future outcomes forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Within an evolving graph, the research agent proposes candidates while world model scores them by forecasting value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility, then accordingly selects, refines, or prunes branches prior to execution. After receiving ground-truth feedback, JANUS distills experience into evolving skills: hierarch

translated_title: JANUS：利用共同演化的世界模型增强长时程自主研究
translated_abstract: 长时程自主研究通过持续的假设生成、实现和验证循环，在加速科学进步方面展现出了巨大的潜力。然而，这种“生成-执行-反馈”范式依赖于被动的试错机制，其中代价高昂且耗时的执行过程会引入严重的反馈延迟，在爆炸式扩展的搜索空间下阻碍了演化进程。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了JANUS，这是一个通过由共同演化的世界模型驱动的“预测-验证-演化”循环，将未来结果预测与过往经验反思统一起来的框架。在一个不断演化的图中，研究智能体提出候选方案，而世界模型通过预测价值提升、信息增益和探索效用对其进行评分，然后在执行前相应地选择、精炼或剪枝分支。在接收到真实反馈后，JANUS将经验蒸馏为不断演化的技能：层次化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: JANUS提出了一种由共同演化的世界模型驱动的“预测-验证-演化”循环框架，通过在执行前预测候选方案的价值提升、信息增益和探索效用来缓解长时程自主研究中的反馈延迟问题，并将反馈经验蒸馏为不断演化的技能。
en_tdlr: JANUS introduces a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model that mitigates feedback delays in long-horizon autonomous research by forecasting candidates' value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility before execution, while distilling feedback experience into evolving skills.
